text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Trainer-kun!
Now then, shall we throw ourselves into training today as well!

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
I actually used my time off to study past footage.
Naturally, analyzing the written documents proved fruitful as well.
In other words, my theories should be even more precise now.

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'm looking forward to
supporting my hypothesis through training.
